title: Pirro Meets With Trump at the White House After He Said She ‘Choked’ in Reflecting Pool Case
summary: President Trump said Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for Washington, D.C., “folded like an umbrella.” For now, her job appeared to be safe, according to two people familiar with the meeting.
